column1: # a5 (10-21 08:30, user: fix the cold/warm decode gap first, R4 later). Root cause: the prefills run without the EAGLE flags,
# so no draft KV / DSA index-K reaches the decode (RESULT §2.13). Step 1 (bring-up with config/stage-b4-spf.sh) was already
# running; after it, only the prefills restart with config/stage-b6-spf-pmtp.sh (PREFILL_MTP=1) while the decode stays up and
# cold (only smoke traffic so far). Two C176 rounds with decode profiles: a5-pmtp on the cold decode is the test (a4-spf cold
# 33,793 / a4-spf2 warm 34,862; k_scatter per call 3.2 ms cold / 0.18 ms warm), a5-pmtp2 checks that nothing drifts.
run start_profile_round.sh ROUND=a5 VARIANT=a5-pmtp CONC=176 DELAY=900
run start_profile_round.sh ROUND=a5 VARIANT=a5-pmtp2 CONC=176 DELAY=900
